name: Beatriz Almeida
bio:
Beatriz Almeida’s journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roaring engines and sleek designs of Formula One cars, sparking a lifelong pursuit of aerodynamic excellence. After graduating from the Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica (ITA), she honed her skills in the Brazilian aerospace industry before transitioning to motorsport, initially focusing on wind tunnel testing and CFD analysis for a local racing team.

Known for her rigorous and data-driven approach, Beatriz rose through the ranks, contributing to championship-winning aerodynamic packages in touring car racing. Her meticulous attention to detail and ability to translate complex simulations into practical on-track improvements have earned her a reputation as a highly competent aero specialist. At Triple Eight Race Engineering, she aims to refine their aerodynamic strategies and push the boundaries of performance through innovation and collaboration.

What sets Beatriz apart is her belief in a holistic approach to aero development, emphasizing not only the raw downforce figures but also the car's balance and stability in various track conditions. She is passionate about mentoring young engineers and fostering a culture of continuous learning within her team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with subtle waves.
physical.description: Beatriz is a woman of medium height with a strong, confident presence and a warm smile that belies her intense focus.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Prefers to conduct team meetings standing up, believing it promotes more active participation.
Has a collection of miniature wind tunnel models on her desk, each representing a milestone in her career.
